title: CripOS ga xush kelibsiz
language_message: Buni keyinroq Crip Center orqali o‘zgartirishingiz mumkin.
internet_offline: Ulanish topilmadi. Sozlashni davom ettirib, keyinroq ulanishingiz mumkin.
updates_hint: Tizim yangilanishlarini sozlash tugagach Crip Update orqali boshqaring.
complete_message: Crip Launcher orqali CripOS’ni o‘rganishni boshlang.
